title: Save and restore equipment list
goal: Use JSON.stringify and JSON.parse to convert between arrays and saveable JSON strings.
summary: The equipment names for field patrol need to be saved in a list. When the page is reopened, the original order, names, and punctuation should be restored.
tasks: reads fieldGear when the page is opened and uses JSON.parse to restore the array. Starts with an empty array when there are no records.
After each addition of non-empty equipment, use JSON.stringify(items) to convert the entire list and save it to fieldGear.
retains existing interface rendering. Enter the equipment name with commas in it and make sure the entire text still appears as the same item.

example.note: route editor will save the city array as JSON text, and then use parse to restore the array after reading it back. Parse the text of an empty array when there are no old values.

hint: If you directly pass the array to setItem, you will get a comma-separated string. Using JSON.stringify you can save the bounds of each item, even if the name itself has commas.
